holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: ICICI Bank received a GST show cause notice on September 30, 2026 for ₹229.14 crore plus interest and penalty.
Anup Bagchi resigned as ICICI Life MD & CEO effective October 13, 2026, succeeded by Sidharatha Mishra.

expected.text: Nomura expects 17% core PPOP growth in Q2 across top private banks including ICICI Bank.

holdings.why_it_matters: ICICI Bank is the fund's largest position at 9.79% weight. Its -3.3% return over 3 months held back overall fund performance within a heavy 39.3% Financials sector weighting.

watch.text: Q2 core PPOP and operating performance across private banking peers.

holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: The bank appointed Anup Bagchi as MD & CEO for a three-year term beginning October 27, 2026.
September 2026 provisional advances stood at ₹33,075 billion and deposits reached ₹33,275 billion.
Foreign institutional investors reduced their stake by 2.4% during the September quarter.

expected.text: Nomura projected 17% core PPOP growth in Q2 for select private lenders including HDFC Bank.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding 7.36% of the portfolio, HDFC Bank was the fund's biggest single detractor over 3 months, posting a -14.27% return and an estimated -1.050% drag.

watch.text: Leadership handover to Anup Bagchi starting October 27, 2026.

holdings.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd

what_changed.text: Airtel introduced new postpaid plans featuring free annual international roaming from October 8, 2026.
Airtel Business launched IQ Gateway, an enterprise communication platform compliant with DPDP rules.
The Department of Telecommunications levied subscriber verification penalties against the company.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 6.46% fund allocation, Airtel's 3-month return of -6.00% resulted in an estimated -0.388% contribution, dampening performance in the 12.9% Technology segment.

watch.text: Traction and revenue realization following the postpaid plan revisions.

holdings.name: Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: The RBI approved Anup Kumar Saha as MD & CEO for three years starting January 1, 2027.
Provisional Q2 FY27 updates showed net advances of ₹5,77,094 crore and deposits of ₹6,51,491 crore.
Subsidiaries KMIL and KAAML approved a scheme of amalgamation.

expected.text: Nomura forecasted 17% core PPOP growth in Q2 for preferred lenders including Kotak Mahindra Bank.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding 6.08% of the fund, Kotak Bank was the top 3-month contributor, returning 16.79% and adding an estimated 1.021% to fund returns.

watch.text: Q2 and half-year FY27 financial results consideration by the board on October 24, 2026.

holdings.name: Titan Company Ltd

what_changed.text: Titan reported a 25% YoY growth in consumer businesses and added 78 stores in Q2 FY27.
The company fully repaid ₹825 crore of commercial paper maturing on October 8, 2026.

expected.text: Managing Director Ajoy Chawla stated the company expects over 20% jewellery growth during the festive season.

seeing.text: While consumer businesses expanded 25% YoY in Q2 FY27, news reports noted jewellery growth missed certain brokerage estimates.

holdings.why_it_matters: Titan represents 5.07% of the fund. A 1-month drop of 11.89% and 3-month drop of 3.8% weighed on the fund's 12.3% Consumer Discretionary basket.

watch.text: Delivery against the targeted festive season jewellery growth rate of over 20%.

holdings.name: Reliance Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: Reliance allotted ₹13,008.6 crore in unsecured NCDs at a 7.90% coupon maturing in 2036.
Rating agencies CARE and CRISIL assigned AAA/Stable ratings to ₹67,000 crore of debentures.

expected.text: European diesel shortages were reported as potentially lifting Q2 O2C earnings by 38% to ₹20,700 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Reliance constitutes 4.76% of the fund and was a primary 3-month detractor, falling 10.51% and reducing portfolio performance by an estimated -0.500%.

watch.text: Valuation and price band milestones ahead of the proposed Jio Platforms listing.

holdings.name: Torrent Pharmaceuticals Ltd

what_changed.text: India Ratings affirmed the company's ratings and revised its outlook to Positive.
Torrent Pharma increased its investment in Torrent Urja 27 to ₹11.88 crore for a 26% stake.

holdings.why_it_matters: Torrent Pharma carries a 4.09% weight in the portfolio. Despite a 3-month decline of 4.99%, it maintains a 31.16% 1-year return within a 10.1% Healthcare allocation.

watch.text: Approval of Q2 FY26 financial results at the board meeting on October 23, 2026.

holdings.name: Axis Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Provisional advances reached ₹13,846 billion and deposits totaled ₹14,521 billion as of September 30, 2026.
Senior manager Sanjeev Moghe submitted his resignation, effective October 30, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Axis Bank is 3.52% of the fund. Its -4.88% 3-month return added to the net negative drag from the fund's 39.3% Financials allocation.

watch.text: Deposit flow trends and foreign currency non-resident account movements.

holdings.name: Bajaj Finserv Ltd

what_changed.text: The board approved subscribing to up to ₹5,800 crore of warrants in Bajaj Finance via preferential allotment.
The company's head of private equity and group strategy superannuated on September 30, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Weighing 3.05% of the portfolio, Bajaj Finserv declined 9.46% over 3 months and 9.98% over 1 month, pulling down returns in the non-bank financial exposure.

watch.text: Review of Q2 and half-year 2026 financial results on November 3, 2026.

holdings.name: Bajaj Auto Ltd

what_changed.text: September 2026 sales rose 5% YoY to 5,38,443 units, bringing six-month volume up 24% to 29,87,135 units.
The RBI interest rate hike led to broad-based share price pullbacks across the automotive sector.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 2.81% fund weight, Bajaj Auto's 1-month fall of 17.07% substantially impacted the fund's recent trajectory in Consumer Discretionary.

watch.text: Q2 FY27 financial results release and earnings conference call on October 27, 2026.

portfolio.statement: HDFC Large Cap Fund holds 53% of its portfolio across its top 10 positions, with 39.3% concentrated in Financials.
interp: Concentrated banking exposure produced sharp divergence, where Kotak Bank's gains were offset by HDFC Bank's steep decline.
Recent rate hikes and quarterly volume reassessments created simultaneous drawdowns across Consumer Discretionary and Energy holdings.
portfolio.line: Heavy financial and retail weights drove a 3-month return of -6.78% as key index heavyweights declined.

drivers.text: Kotak Mahindra Bank provided the largest positive 3-month offset with an estimated +1.021% contribution following leadership approval and strong business updates.
HDFC Bank generated an estimated -1.050% 3-month drag as foreign institutional selling reached 2.4% during the September quarter.
An RBI rate hike triggered valuation adjustments across interest-rate-sensitive auto and consumer names.
